The public website has no account, contact form or analytics service. Standard server logs may contain an IP address, request time, requested path, browser information and security events.
Logs are processed to deliver the site, maintain security, diagnose faults and establish or defend legal claims. Processing is limited to what is necessary for these legitimate operational purposes.

Logs are retained only for the period needed for security and operations, then deleted or anonymised. Hosting and infrastructure providers may process limited data under their service terms and applicable data-protection obligations.
Requests concerning access, correction, deletion, restriction or objection may be sent to the contact address. Rights are assessed under the law applicable to the person and processing activity.
